## What's changed

- Fixed standard upscaling on FFmpeg builds without zscale by adding a portable Spline fallback.
- Upgraded the macOS package to a full FFmpeg runtime with VideoToolbox, zscale, and libplacebo validation.
- Made hardware detection use a lightweight capability probe while retaining real-resolution validation during playback.
- Improved NVIDIA detection reliability and automatic AMD/Intel device-group and Vulkan driver setup in Docker.
- Corrected direct HLS remuxes being reported as software transcoding and clarified detected versus active hardware settings.
- Reworked the macOS workflow to use a reliable source artifact instead of a direct GitHub tarball download.

These are server-side updates; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
